# Eating in Destin

> Restaurant guide for Destin and Miramar Beach, Florida.

Eating in Destin is a restaurant guide for Destin and Miramar Beach. Find breakfast, lunch, and dinner from the Harbor to Crystal Beach, with the address, the hours, and a feel for the place.

The areas in the guide are Miramar Beach, Sandestin, Grand Boulevard, Destin Commons, Mid-Destin, Destin Harbor, and Crystal Beach.

- [Home](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/)
- [Restaurants](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/restaurants/)
- [Map](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/map/)
- [Areas](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/areas/)
- [About](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/about/): A restaurant guide for Destin and Miramar Beach.
- [Contact](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/contact/): Send a correction, edit, deletion, or new listing.

## Areas

- [Miramar Beach](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/areas/miramar-beach/): The western edge of the guide, with beach restaurants along Scenic Gulf Drive, Silver Sands, and US 98.
- [Sandestin](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/areas/sandestin/): Baytowne Wharf, the marina, and the resort hotels, with waterfront dining inside Sandestin.
- [Grand Boulevard](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/areas/grand-boulevard/): The Sandestin town center north of the bay, with sit-down restaurants around the square.
- [Destin Commons](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/areas/destin-commons/): The open-air shopping center in Destin, with casual dining along the commons and Commons Drive.
- [Mid-Destin](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/areas/mid-destin/): The US 98 stretch through Destin, with everyday restaurants between the harbor and Sandestin.
- [Destin Harbor](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/areas/destin-harbor/): HarborWalk Village and the Destin Harbor docks, with seafood houses on the water.
- [Crystal Beach](https://eatingindestin.352marc.workers.dev/areas/crystal-beach/): The east end of Destin along Scenic 98, including Henderson Beach and the gulf-front inns.
